$comment: Per-route weight budgets, gzipped: the document plus the scripts and stylesheets it
actually references. Checked by scripts/check-performance-budget.mjs in CI.
Baseline measured 2026-08-12. Each budget sits roughly 8-10% above what the route
weighs today: enough headroom for ordinary work, tight enough that adding a library
has to be a decision rather than an accident.
Raising a number here is allowed and sometimes correct. Say why in the pull request.
Raising it silently is how a fast site stops being one.
